title: Accessing and Navigating the ZPC Admin Portal

blocks.text: This article covers the following topics:

blocks.item: Signing in to the ZPC Admin Portal
Accepting the End User Subscription Agreement (EUSA)
Navigating within the ZPC Admin Portal

blocks.text: After your organization is provisioned for Zscaler Posture Control (ZPC), you will receive an email with the tenant ID and a link to reset the password. After you reset the password, you can sign in to the ZPC Admin Portal.
When the Login page appears:

blocks.item: Enter your Login ID. This is your registered email ID.

blocks.text: When you set up the IdP configuration, all the users in a particular tenant of your organization can log in using SSO.
If your account is configured to use single sign-on (SSO):
You are redirected to your IdP's login page.
If you are logged in successfully, you are redirected back to the ZPC Admin Portal. To learn more, see Configuring SAML for SSO.
If the IdP is enabled for your organization but you're not able to log in because of IdP issues, then you can log in as Breakglass Admin directly.

blocks.item: On the Login page, click Sign in as Breakglass Admin.

blocks.text: The administrator can log in using the Breakglass Admin option directly (with local credentials) even when the IdP is enabled.

You can enable Just-In-Time (JIT) provisioning to allow ZPC to automatically provision a user on log-in. An IdP-initiated login is required for ZPC to retrieve user information from IdP and provision a user in ZPC. To learn more, see Adding an IdP Configuration.
JIT does not work with SP-initiated login.
When you log in for the first time, the ZPC Admin Portal displays the EUSA. Accept the EUSA. If you click Cancel, the ZPC Admin Portal logs you out automatically. You can read the full EUSA any time.
The ZPC Admin Portal has the following items in the left-side navigation:
Click Dashboard to view the different dashboards in the ZPC Admin Portal.
Click Alerts to view and analyze the alerts, and configure and manage alert rules. To learn more, see About Alerts.
Click Investigation to investigate cloud assets and cloud identities using alerts generated by security policies. To learn more, see About Investigation.
Click Analytics to access the executive report.
Click the Notifications icon to view the notifications related to your assets.
Click Policies to apply various security policy controls. To learn more, see About Security Policies
Click Cloud Posture to view the compliance benchmarks, cloud identities, cloud assets, and vulnerability details.

Click the Profile icon to view your tenant details, the assigned group and role, email address, and the reports you've downloaded. To learn more, see Viewing User Profile. If you are assigned to multiple user groups, then the list of groups is displayed. You can select the required group to access ZPC modules based on the group's roles and permissions. To learn more, see About Groups.
Click the Log Out icon to log out of the ZPC Admin Portal.

Click Administration to configure and manage Cloud Accounts, Version Control & CI/CD Systems, Workstations & IDEs, Container Registry & Workloads, Integrations, Business Unit Management, Audit Logs, Single Sign On, Scheduled Reports, and API Keys.
When you are ready to begin configuring ZPC, see the Step-by-Step Configuration Guide for ZPC.
